digest.component_or_area: verify policies and lifecycle enforcement for rebar project
propositions: Enable both verify.enforce_plan_material_pins and verify.require_plan_review_for_close in rebar.toml while retaining false defaults in the reusable configuration schema.

End-to-end lifecycle tests must prove direct and natural-transitive invalidation only after actual narrow material changes, and unchanged successful re-review produces no further downstream propagation.

Legacy unpinned attestations and stale material-pin drift must be handled correctly: unpinned claims succeed, stale pins reject with exit 1 and stale-pin-drift reason, and close-plan review incompatibility rejects with exit 1 and review-plan instruction.

Outgoing depends_on and inbound blocks references normalize to one canonical prerequisite pin and evaluation without eager backfill, graph-wide invalidation events, new pin commands, or stored relation migrations.

Execution adaptation, return-to-open reset, code-only close freshness, enable/disable/re-enable behavior, deleted and archived target handling, and concurrency recheck behavior must be proven through public lifecycle surfaces.
